{"script":"mkdir -p temp_check
if declare -p var >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    declare -p var > temp_check/var_raw.txt
    echo "$var" >> temp_check/var_raw.txt

        echo "true: it is an integer" > temp_check/var_verification.txt
    else

        echo "false: it is not an integer" > temp_check/var_verification.txt
    fi
    [ -f temp_check/var_normalized.txt ] && rm temp_check/var_normalized.txt
else
    echo "n/a" > temp_check/var_conversion.txt
    echo "false: var not defined" > temp_check/var_verification.txt
fi

cp temp_check/var_verification.txt temp_check/ready_for_decision.txt
ls -la temp_check
"}

function.arguments:
{"script":"# Ensure temp_check exists
mkdir -p temp_check

# 2. Raw capture
if declare -p var >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    declare -p var > temp_check/var_raw.txt
    echo "$var" >> temp_check/var_raw.txt
    val="$var"
else
    echo "var is not defined" > temp_check/var_raw.txt
    val=""
fi

# 3. Normalized
echo "$val" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//' > temp_check/var_normalized.txt

# 4. Conversion
norm_val=$(cat temp_check/var_normalized.txt)
if [[ -n "$norm_val" && "$norm_val" =~ ^-?[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    echo "$norm_val" > temp_check/var_conversion.txt
    echo "Success" >> temp_check/var_conversion.txt
    is_int=true
else
    echo "Failure: '$norm_val' is not an integer" > temp_check/var_conversion.txt
    is_int=false
fi

# 5. Verification
if [ "$is_int" = true ]; then
    echo "true: var is an integer" > temp_check/var_verification.txt
else
    echo "false: var is not an integer" > temp_check/var_verification.txt
fi

# 6. Cleanup
rm temp_check/var_normalized.txt

# 7. Ready for decision
cp temp_check/var_verification.txt temp_check/ready_for_decision.txt

# Output the value of var and the verification for my own confirmation
echo "VAR_VALUE: $val"
cat temp_check/var_verification.txt
"}
